access_surface: Linux or Colab notebook with a 16GB-class GPU target
prompt_guidance: Use TRELLIS only when the primary Hunyuan pass cannot land silhouette or topology.
Keep source references and prompt deltas documented so retries stay comparable.
Do not expand TRELLIS use into the default lane while the Hunyuan-first policy stands.
provenance_notes: Record why the Hunyuan pass failed before switching to TRELLIS.
Capture any reference images or conditioning notes used for the TRELLIS run.
Keep retry lineage attached to the same pack provenance.
review_checklist: Retry output clearly improves over the rejected primary pass.
Topology and naming can be normalized with the same Blender cleanup profile.
The final payload still lands in the same reviewed publish target.
setup_steps: Use a Linux or Colab environment because the official setup is Linux-only and expects a 16GB-class GPU.
Clone the official repository with submodules and run the repo setup path instead of hand-assembling dependencies.
Favor the image-conditioned path first because the official project states that image-to-3D is more mature than text-to-3D.
progression_steps: Enter TRELLIS only after naming the Hunyuan failure mode that you are trying to fix.
Keep the retry focused on one asset and compare it against the same acceptance bar, not a lower one.
Export the improved result, run the same Blender cleanup, and preserve the retry lineage in provenance.
runbook: Use only after a specific Hunyuan failure mode is identified.
Compare TRELLIS output against the same acceptance bar, not a lower one.
Archive prompt diffs in the pack provenance.
